contexts.text: Mina reads a short story in English each evening. First, she tries to understand the basic meaning without a dictionary. She identifies important words she does not recognize and guesses their meanings from the context. Later, she goes through the story again and checks her guesses. She keeps a record of useful words, an example sentence and any special preposition. A translation sometimes helps, but she does not translate every word. Once a week, she revises her notebook and tries to use the new words in a conversation.

Omid and Leo became friends during a language course. They had a lot in common, including a similar sense of humour. When Leo moved to another city, they promised to keep in touch. They now call each other on Sundays and sometimes meet for a weekend. Omid trusts Leo because he is honest and always tells the truth. Leo knows he can rely on Omid for support. They sometimes disagree about films, but a difference in their likes and dislikes does not damage their friendship.

This is a fictional local project. During several hot summers, a community group noticed that its hall became uncomfortable in the afternoon. The group planted trees outside and added shade above the windows. It also recorded the temperature at the same time each day. The changes did not solve the global problem of climate change, but the measurements helped the group understand the local effects of heat. Members now explain the difference between a short heatwave and a long-term change in climate. They share their results rather than making predictions from one unusual day.

Start at the petrol station and follow the main road towards the town centre. Stay on the pavement. After the road bends to the left, you will see traffic lights and a marked crossing. Cross there when it is safe. Continue past the tram tracks, keeping to the walking area. The road divides at a roundabout, but you do not need to cross it. The library entrance is on your side of the road, just before the roundabout. There are street lights along the route.
